notes: Lock Protection Center adds Standard, Guarded, and Maximum workflow profiles.
Maximum protection requires an exact Preview Guard approval, current capacity headroom, a PIN, and a recent matching recovery test.
Capacity checks are bounded, metadata-only, privacy-safe, and never read file contents.
Account session controls add current-session logout, targeted session revocation, and owner logout-all without collecting IP addresses or device names.
Keys, licenses, settings, vault data, audit logs, and locked files remain untouched.
